letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden hues we first shared on that February day, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. I love how you turn ordinary moments into adventures, and how your laugh lights up my heart even across the miles. You’re my forever cutie, my confidante, my home wherever we are. Thank you for filling our life with warmth, humor, and endless love—today and always.
poem:
In desert sands or river’s sigh,  
Your smile’s the sun that paints the sky.  
Across two worlds, our hearts entwine,  
Together, love, forever fine.
